title: ageratina havanensis
intro: Ageratina havanensis, commonly known as Cuban shrub or Cuban ironwort, is a plant species in the mint family. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, which provide several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina havanensis include pain relief, reduction of fever, and wound healing, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. Research suggests that the bioactive constituents of Ageratina havanensis may play a role in modulating the immune system and have potential applications in the treatment of various diseases.
